```text
# #4456: Patch: follow-up to #4419 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4419 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4419 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44980007181)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`dd441f06baa7`). `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4419 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/cards/src/history.rs:1180`: Shadowstep's kept-script row is keyed at v0.6.9f, but v0.6.9g had already shipped when #4419 merged. Games recorded at v0.6.9g ran the old trigger (it answered any destroyed card of yours) but now fold under the new Units-only script, so any such game where a Field Spell or Trap of that player was destroyed with a base Shadowstep set fails its recorded final hash (R767000).
  Evidence: `crates/cards/patches/patches.json` ends with v0.6.9f and then v0.6.9g (dated 2026-11-22). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4a7e988aae HEAD` succeeds: `patches ship: v0.6.9g (#4437)`, 01:22 UTC, is an ancestor of the merge dd441f06ba, 02:52 UTC. `covering_at` (history.rs:1425) only uses a row whose key comes at or after the replayed version, so v0.6.9g matches no Shadowstep row. The test `r767000_issue_4395_shadowstep_is_kept_through_v0_6_9f_…` (history.rs:1802) checks versions only up to v0.6.9f and has no `after` assertion, so it cannot catch this. This is the same mistake #4086 fixed for earlier rows. Fix: re-key the row at v0.6.9g (exactly that version, not whatever is newest when the follow-up is built). Rename `script_v0_6_9f` to `script_v0_6_9g` in c014_shadowstep.rs and update its kept-script test. Update the version named in spec/rulings/R4395000.md (Replays bullet), spec/pending/4395.md and the fragment's `notes`. Switch the history test to `assert_kept_through(&[c014_shadowstep::ID], &[…, "v0.6.9f", "v0.6.9g"], "<first version shipped after #4419>")` once that version exists, or else at least assert v0.6.9g maps to the row.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot from the after-merge spot-check (one in 5 medium or hard merges, `spot_check_every`): `claude-7` (`claude`) built #4419 and `muse` (`muse-spark-1.3-contributor`) approved it. This issue's own pull request is never spot-checked.

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44980848323)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Shadowstep's kept script row is re-keyed from v0.6.9f to v0.6.9g, exactly that version, so games recorded at v0.6.9g (which ran the old any-destroyed-card trigger) fold under the old Units-only-excluded script instead of falling through to the new one and failing their recorded final hash (R767000). Every version string naming v0.6.9f as the newest version that ran the old trigger moves to v0.6.9g: the row, the kept function name, its tests, the R4395000 note, the §11 pending paragraph, and the pending fragment's notes.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/history.rs` | change | `KEPT_SCRIPTS` Shadowstep row key and function reference (line 1180); the `#4395` comment above it (line 1179); the kept-through test (lines 1798–1816) |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c014_shadowstep.rs` | change | Rename `script_v0_6_9f` to `script_v0_6_9g` (line 157) and its doc comment (line 155); the line 63 `units_only` comment; the kept-scripts behavior test (lines 726, 730) |
| `spec/rulings/R4395000.md` | change | Replays bullet (line 15): versions and kept-script name |
| `spec/pending/4395.md` | change | R4395000 paragraph (line 1): version named as kept |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/shadowstep-answers-only-your-units-that-die.json` | change | `notes` field: kept version |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; the generated `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`; no new ruling note and no new pending fragment (a re-key claims no catalog change, as in the #4090 precedent). Governing spec: §4.5, §8.6 row 14, §10.3 (`destroyed`'s `animated`), rulings R4395000, R4395001, R767000, plus R172, R383, R1081000 cited by the note.

## Steps

1. In `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c014_shadowstep.rs`, rename `pub fn script_v0_6_9f` to `pub fn script_v0_6_9g` (line 157), keeping its body (`scripts(true, false)`) byte-identical. Update its doc comment (line 155: "v0.6.9f and every version before it" → "v0.6.9g and every version before it") and the line 63 comment ("what v0.6.9f and before ran" → "what v0.6.9g and before ran"). Follow the #4090 rename pattern (commit `93438a9957`, e.g. its `c019_2_jungle_loser.rs` hunk): rename the function and every comment naming the old version, change nothing else.
2. In the same file's `r4395000_the_kept_scripts_still_answer_a_destroyed_field_spell_of_yours` (lines 726–730), change the pair `("v0.6.9f", script_v0_6_9f())` to `("v0.6.9g", script_v0_6_9g())` and the doc comment on line 726 to name v0.6.9g. Assert behavior is unchanged: under each kept script a destroyed Field Spell still springs the trap and returns at cost 0.
3. In `crates/cards/src/history.rs` line 1180, re-key the row to `(c014_shadowstep::ID, "v0.6.9g", c014_shadowstep::script_v0_6_9g)` and update the line 1179 comment to name v0.6.9g as the last Shadowstep trigger that answered any destroyed card of yours.
4. In `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, replace the test `r767000_issue_4395_shadowstep_is_kept_through_v0_6_9f_the_newest_version_that_ran_it` (lines 1798–1816) with a test named `r767000_issue_4395_shadowstep_is_kept_through_v0_6_9g_the_newest_version_that_ran_it` that keeps the `assert_eq!(kept_at("v0.4.12b"), Some("v0.4.12b"))` line and then calls the existing `assert_kept_through` helper (lines 1766–1782) as `assert_kept_through(&[c014_shadowstep::ID], &["v0.4.12c", "v0.4.12d", "v0.5.0", "v0.6.9", "v0.6.9e", "v0.6.9f", "v0.6.9g"], "v0.6.9h")`, copying the shape of the `r767000_issue_4331` test at lines 1787–1796. v0.6.9h is the first version shipped after #4419: commit `3df987d48c` (2026-11-22 03:27 UTC) promotes the #4419 fragment at `dd441f06ba` (02:52 UTC).
5. In `spec/rulings/R4395000.md` line 15, change the Replays bullet to "The games of v0.6.9g and before fold under the script they ran (`script_v0_6_9g`, …)". Leave `proven_in` as is (it cites the file, not the function name).
6. In `spec/pending/4395.md` line 1, change "The script of v0.6.9f is kept for its replays" to "The script of v0.6.9g is kept for its replays".
7. In `crates/cards/patches/pending/shadowstep-answers-only-your-units-that-die.json`, change the `notes` field's "its v0.6.9f script is kept for replays" to "its v0.6.9g script is kept for replays". Change nothing else in the fragment.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r767000_issue_4395` — the rewritten kept-through test: v0.4.12b maps to its row; every version from v0.4.12c through v0.6.9g maps to the v0.6.9g row; v0.6.9h maps to no Shadowstep row.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r767000` — includes the params-consistency test proving the kept script declares the numbers of every version it covers (classic-014's snapshot entries are identical in v0.6.9f and v0.6.9g, verified from `crates/cards/patches/v0.6.9f.json` vs `v0.6.9g.json`).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c014_shadowstep` — the card's full suite, including the kept-scripts-still-answer test.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh spec check` (the ruling note, its proving tests, and the R-ids cited in code must agree per CLAUDE.md rule 3).

## Done when

- `KEPT_SCRIPTS` keys Shadowstep's old-trigger row at exactly v0.6.9g, and `covering_at` maps v0.6.9g (and every version back to the v0.4.12b row) to it while newer versions use the build's own script.
- No file cites `script_v0_6_9f` or names v0.6.9f as the newest version that ran the old trigger.
- All commands under Tests pass with no test skipped, ignored, weakened, or deleted.

## Risks

- Keying at any version newer than v0.6.9g would fold games that ran the new Units-only script under the old one; keying older leaves v0.6.9g games failing their hash. v0.6.9g is the exact newest version that ran the old trigger (v0.6.9g shipped 01:22 UTC, before the #4419 merge at 02:52 UTC; its snapshot's classic-014 entry equals v0.6.9f's).
- The `after` leg of the rewritten test (`"v0.6.9h"`) passes vacuously in this worktree because `patches.json` ends at v0.6.9g so `covering_at` returns `None` for unknown versions; it becomes a live check once v0.6.9h is carried. The substantive legs (v0.6.9f and v0.6.9g mapping to the row) are fully exercised here.
- Renaming a `pub fn` could break other cites: a repo-wide search shows the only cites are the row, the definition, and the two test uses above; the cross-crate `code_blocks.rs` test has no Shadowstep kept-script cite.

## Open questions

None.
```
